question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. 

To renovate or improve
solution:
The correct answer is **Revamp**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revamp** means to change something in order to make it more attractive or more modern (अधिक आकर्षक या आधुनिक बनाने के लिए बदलाव लाना; नया रूप देना, नवीकरण करना)__

 __
 
• ​Example: *We **revamped** the management system, but the business is doing no better than it was before. *
 
 

Hence, we can say that the correct substitute for the above description is **Revamp**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Relocate: **move to a new place and establish one's home or business there (स्थानांतरित करना)
 
• **Resume: **begin again or continue after a pause or interruption (फिर शुरू करना)
 
• **Revalue: **assess the value of (something) again (पुनर्मूल्यांकन)
